customer.business: StepUp — a free Android running app with crews, crew runs and a points/virtual-sneaker game layer (Korea)
customer.target: Korean recreational runners, 20 to 45, who run at least once a week, alone or with a running crew
customer.where: Korea (Seoul and other cities), Google Play

behaviours.name: Crew regular
behaviours.how: Runs with a crew found on Instagram or a KakaoTalk open chat, meets once or twice a week.

behaviours.name: Tracker loyalist
behaviours.how: Already logs every run in Nike Run Club, Strava or the watch app and has years of history there.

behaviours.name: Reward hunter
behaviours.how: Uses walking-reward apps and checks what the points are actually worth before bothering.

behaviours.name: Restarting runner
behaviours.how: Wants to get back into running after quitting before, needs something to keep going.

behaviours.name: Gear and data nerd
behaviours.how: Wears a Garmin, cares about GPS, pace and heart-rate accuracy, syncs everything.

behaviours.name: Burned by move-to-earn
behaviours.how: Played a move-to-earn token app in 2022, lost money, distrusts anything with tokens or sneakers to buy.

behaviours.name: Social only
behaviours.how: Runs only when friends invite them.

objections: I already have years of runs in Strava, NRC or my watch app
Points I can't cash out are pointless
This sounds like STEPN again, will it collapse?
My crew already organises on KakaoTalk and Instagram, why move?
Will it drain my battery, and is the GPS accurate?
Android only, half my crew uses iPhone
Another app that wants my location all the time
habits: you run along the Han River two or three evenings a week
you do a Saturday morning group run with your crew
you check your phone for step-count rewards every morning
you are training for a 10 km race in the spring
you mostly run on a treadmill at the gym after work

pitch:
StepUp — 러닝 크루 (Android, Google Play, 무료)
GPS로 러닝 경로·거리·페이스·랩을 기록하고, 크루를 만들어 같은 방에서 함께 출발하는 "크루 러닝"을 해요. 크루원이 함께 달린 거리가 쌓이면 크루 레벨이 올라요.
달리면 앱 안 포인트(SUP)가 쌓이고, 무료 뽑기로 받은 가상 신발을 포인트로 수리·강화하며 키워요. 포인트는 현금으로 바꿀 수 없어요.
광고·유료 결제 없음. 안드로이드 전용(아이폰 앱 없음).
